summary: Advances a linked-list iteration cursor stored at this+0x8. Reads the current node pointer; when non-null, advances it to the next node through the link field at node+0x4 (evidence field:this:0xC). Reloads the cursor; when non-null returns the node's data value at node+0, otherwise returns 0. Null-safe at both stages so a full traversal ends cleanly.

operations.description: Load the current node pointer from this+0x8 into a local.
If the current node is non-null, advance the cursor through the node link field.
Advance the cursor: this+0x8 = next-node pointer read through the link field at node+0x4 (this+0xC in the evidence model).
Reload the cursor into a local; if null, the list is exhausted and the function returns 0.
Return the data value at node+0 when the new current node is non-null, else return 0.

unresolved: Node payload type and link-field layout are caller-defined; callers sub_490D00, CollisionBroadphaseBuilder and NetworkConnectionListDuplication drive the iteration.
Semantics of the node+0 data value (pointer, id, or count) are not determinable from this function alone.
The this+0xC field is written by this function's own cursor advance, not read from this itself; the exact mapping to node+0x4 rests on the analyzer's evidence model.
